disclosure: Identities only: paths, sizes and sha256. No seed, world hash or evaluator truth. `core` is what `verify` recomputes; everything else is a dated observation. Nothing was copied, uploaded, allocated, generated, trained or evaluated.
mustNotBeClaimed: that the historical exclusion loaders are importable from a clean checkout (only the new portable loader is)
that evaluation is reproducible from a clean checkout alone (the protected source and local data are still required)
that an evidence bundle or a backup exists (only the tooling and the acceptance procedure do)
that any block is allocated or free
that a campaign is authorized or ready

backupAcceptanceRecordFields.recordedAt: ISO-8601 date of the restore verification

attestedBy.role: OWNER (a human; never a model or a script)
attestedBy.name: the attesting person

source.head: the 40-hex commit that was backed up
source.scopeSha256: the scope sha256 printed by `backup.mjs run`
source.bundleBytes: size of the git bundle in bytes

medium.label: how the owner identifies the medium

restoreVerify.outputSha256: sha256 of the exact JSON text printed by restore-verify

backupAcceptanceRecordFields.evidenceBundle: optional { bundleId, manifestSha256 } of the SENTINEL_EVIDENCE_BUNDLE_V1 manifest issued from the same state
backupAcceptanceRecordFields.recordSha256: sha256 over the canonical record without this field
